title: Satisfaction of a Tseitin clause chain
statement: Let an assignment be a sign vector on $n$ variables, let $L$ be a finite list of literals, and let $A$ be a finite list of auxiliary literals. If every clause in the Tseitin clause chain formed from $L$ and $A$ contains a literal that holds under the assignment, then $L$ itself contains a literal that holds under the assignment.
hypotheses_covered: the assignment is a sign vector of length $n$
$L$ is a finite list of literals
$A$ is a finite list of auxiliary literals
every clause in the specified Tseitin clause chain is satisfied by the assignment
